name: Cornerstone
overview: Scripture reveals the cornerstone as a foundational element both literally and figuratively, with Job 38:6 highlighting its role in establishing the foundations. Psalms 118:22 and Matthew 21:42 emphasize the cornerstone as the stone rejected by builders but exalted as the chief cornerstone, a theme echoed in Mark 12:10. Isaiah 28:16 presents the cornerstone as a tried and precious stone laid by God in Zion, assuring believers of a sure foundation. Additionally, Psalms 144:12 uses the image of polished cornerstones to signify strength and beauty, symbolizing the people shaped by God’s design.
